diffuseAlbedo.source: Palette.json: accent.negro-marquina research.needed (no substance record yet)
diffuseAlbedo.note: A first near-black for a fine black limestone, read from trade photographs; to be measured on a specimen.

refractiveIndex.source: Substances/cream-marble.json: optics.specularF0 (0.0533, calcite grains in random orientations)
refractiveIndex.derivation: n = (1 + sqrt(F0)) / (1 - sqrt(F0)), the index whose normal-incidence reflectance is the record's F0

porosity.source: Levantina, 'Negro Marquina Marmol / Marble: Ficha tecnica | Technical file' (March 2025), p. 03 table: Porosidad abierta / Open porosity 0.3 % (UNE-EN 1936); water absorption 0.1 % (UNE-EN 13755); apparent density 2700 kg/m3; p. 04: ASTM C 97-09 absorption 0.13 %, bulk specific gravity 2699 kg/m3, https://www.levantina.com/files/74b9d95b0cbb53ef86851135a9b72c53/20004873/1/12-negro-marquina-ficha-v2.pdf
porosity.note: Verified. The ASTM figures are on p. 04 of the sheet, not p. 03. The sheet's 'Nature' section describes the stone as a limestone biomicrite with rudist and oyster (ostreid) remains, about 115 Ma (early Aptian to late Albian, Early Cretaceous), with calcite veins and scattered fossils. Its UNE-EN 12407 petrographic name is 'Caliza / Limestone'.

grain.note: A fine black limestone with white calcite veins.

bed.note: A first value for the band or bed a honed face shows, until a specimen is measured.

bedAspect.note: How much finer the veining is across its run than along it, read from trade photographs.

hurst.source: Candela et al. 2012, Journal of Geophysical Research 117, B08409 (fault surfaces, 0.6 to 0.8; cited in Stone.ush)
hurst.note: The middle of the range measured on rock surfaces, as the travertine's.

toneSpread.note: A first half-range of ln(albedo) across a face, from its veins and clasts.

roughnessSpread.source: Workings/honed.json: unverified surface.microRoughness (no filtered roughness read)
roughnessSpread.note: A first half-range of ln(roughness) across a honed face, as the travertine's.
